learn.text: (x² + x − 6) ÷ (x − 2)Bring down 1. 1 × 2 = 2; 1 + 2 = 3. 3 × 2 = 6; −6 + 6 = 0.Bottom row 1, 3, 0 means x + 3, remainder 0.
